## Peer-Reviewed Publications

::: {.pub-item}

<div class="pub-title">
Maximizing the Expected Value of Experimentation for Finding Top-κ Rank via Aggregation of Pairwise Comparisons
</div>

**Forough Mahpouya**, Courtney J. Burris, Himangshu Paul, and Alexander Nikolaev

<div class="pub-meta">
IISE Transactions · 2026
</div>

This work develops an Expected Value of Experimentation framework for identifying informative pairwise comparisons in top-κ ranking problems.

<div class="pub-links">
[Article](https://doi.org/10.1080/24725854.2026.2645062)
</div>

:::


::: {.pub-item}

<div class="pub-title">
Design of a Robust T² Control Chart, a Re-Sampling Approach
</div>

**Forough Mahpouya**, Hamid Shahriari, and Emad Roghanian

<div class="pub-meta">
Quality and Reliability Engineering International · 38(2), 924–940 · 2022
</div>

This work develops a resampling-based robust multivariate control chart for process monitoring under limited samples and outliers.

<div class="pub-links">
[Article](https://doi.org/10.1002/qre.3022)
</div>

:::
